about_the_game:
Step into Key Studios, once a celebrated mascot studio known for its cheerful characters and live shows. You are a YouTuber seeking content for your next big upload, but what you thought would be a simple exploration quickly turns into a nightmarish ordeal. The mascots of Key Studios aren’t as lifeless as they once seemed…

The Specters Show is a first-person mascot horror experience that combines stealth, exploration, and tense survival. Navigate dark offices, dusty soundstages, and backstage storage as you uncover the terrifying secrets hidden within the studio. Every room, every hallway, and every prop could hide a lurking horror — or a glimpse of the mascots’ twisted forms.

Features

  • Creepy Mascot Encounters: Meet the haunting first mascot of the parade in Chapter 1, with unsettling movements, eerie sounds, and unpredictable behavior.

  • Exploration-Based Horror: Investigate offices, stages, storage rooms, and backstage areas to uncover lore and hidden clues.

  • Tense Stealth Mechanics: Hide behind props, crouch in shadows, and carefully time your movements to avoid being caught.

  • Immersive Atmosphere: Flickering lights, distorted audio logs, and environmental storytelling create a deeply unsettling experience.

  • YouTuber Perspective: Play as a content creator documenting your exploration — the camera adds both gameplay mechanics and tension.

  • Lore-Rich World: Discover notes, tapes, and recordings revealing Key Studios’ dark past and the origin of the haunted mascots.

  • Progressive Chapters: Start with the surface-level studio in Chapter 1, and prepare to descend into deeper, more twisted areas in future chapters.

  • Jump Scares & Psychological Horror: Expect sudden mascot appearances, unsettling props, and an ever-present sense of being watched.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 / AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Low settings for textures, shadows, and post-processing effects.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: High-quality textures, advanced lighting/shadowing, post-processing, smooth 60+ FPS.
